anchor: a check's regex on a glyph run is locale-bound: `grep -E "(─)+"` (BRE: parens literal), never `─+`; awk length: bytes (agent-harness-2026-10-29-2 2026-10-29)
text: A check file name may not hold or sit inside another (suite-runner.sh namelint): requests-inbox.sh fails on inbox.sh (agent-harness-2026-11-07-3 2026-11-07)
why: A spec named a check file the name lint rejects, forcing renames across two milestones; planners and coders read this before naming a file.

text: A verify session that mutates code to prove a check catches a bug should not do it while its background full suite runs: run the mutation after it ends.
why: A mutation made during a background full suite run can turn unrelated checks red and muddle the verify verdict.
